run_generate_cmd: run the generate command to generate video content from a prompt using DiffGenerator
add_multimodal_gen_generate_args: add CLI arguments for the generate subcommand including config, perf-dump-path, and output-file-path options
create_gsd_generate_subcommand: create a GenerateSubcommand instance that registers the generate subcommand with argparse and validates arguments
dump_performance_metrics: dump performance metrics and memory snapshots to a JSON file after generation completes
apply_output_file_path_override: apply output file path override to split a single output_file_path into output_path and output_file_name
